entries.claim: Holy Trinity, may this act of my service please You. Grant that the sacrifice which I, though unworthy, have offered before Your majesty may be acceptable to You and, through Your mercy, propitiatory for me and for all for whom I offered it. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
